_about: Single source of truth for Phase & LUCID documentation: sidebar order, titles, summaries, ⌘K search index, sitemap, and llms.txt. Each entry maps to site/help/<slug>.md.

pages.title: Install LUCID
pages.summary: Download and verify LUCID on macOS Apple Silicon (.dmg or CLI), Linux (.deb or tarball), Windows (PowerShell installer), or build from source.

pages.title: Your first chat and joining a circle
pages.summary: Use the built-in streaming Desktop chat, read trust badges, create and accept one-time lucid://join/ invitations, and connect Ollama clients like Open WebUI.

pages.title: Models, Ollama import and sharing your GPU
pages.summary: Read-only local GGUF discovery from Ollama and LM Studio, permission-gated GPU sharing, verified P2P model downloads with exact-offset resume, and pinning llama.cpp b12651.

pages.title: Operator policy and safety controls
pages.summary: Complete reference for policy.toml and node.toml: hot-reload, SIGHUP, battery and thermal auto-pause, time-of-day windows, concurrency caps, and default-deny allowlists.

pages.title: Workers and GPU backends
pages.summary: How llama.cpp (Metal, CUDA, ROCm, Vulkan, CPU), Apple Silicon MLX, and the echo dev worker isolate keys, strip co-tenant KV caches, report /api/ps residency, and handle crashes.

pages.title: Pool GPUs across machines (Tier-1 Trusted-Circle)
pages.summary: Split large GGUF models across trusted machines over Noise-encrypted /phase/shard-rpc/1.0.0 with auto-managed SHA-256-pinned ggml-rpc-server, RPC-first tensor splits, and SSH-equivalent trust boundaries.

pages.title: Run a Cloud Relay and Tor/Tails guidance
pages.summary: Deploy an unprivileged Linux Circuit Relay v2 node on port 443 or 4001 with setup-cloud-relay.sh, configure PeerID-pinned DNS TXT bootstrap, and run consume-only nodes over TailsOS/Tor.

pages.title: HTTP API reference
pages.summary: Every Ollama-compatible /api/* endpoint, every Bearer-authenticated /api/lucid/* control endpoint, request limits, options allowlists, custom headers, and all five X-Lucid-Trust-Label values.

pages.title: CLI, subcommands and environment variables
pages.summary: Every lucidd subcommand (probe, models, peers, invite, join, bench, cluster), all daemon flags grouped by role, and every runtime, desktop, and signing environment variable.

pages.title: Phase network protocols and wire formats
pages.summary: Wire specifications for all seven /phase/* libp2p protocols, framing and size bounds, admission pools, Kademlia/Relay v2/DCUtR/AutoNAT behaviours, and all ten DHT key namespaces.

pages.title: Cryptography, receipts and verification
pages.summary: Ed25519 NodeIdentity and PeerId binding, SignedManifest, SignedReceipt, streaming CommitmentAccumulator replay, composite shard chains, DHT rollback and equivocation protection, and verification limits.

pages.title: Workspace architecture, crates and Plasm
pages.summary: All eight Rust crates, the Apache-2.0 substrate vs AGPL-3.0-or-later flagship license split, #![deny(unsafe_code)], the Plasm WASM node, phase-artifact-server, Desktop security boundaries, and release signing.
